soundness_flags.one_line: The model fixes only the endpoint conditional means of the finite score vector, while the claimed Lévy law depends on the full unspecified endpoint mark law G_a; add conditional-law convergence to G_a (or a direct score-vector law condition) so the asserted limit is identified by the assumptions.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The primary version defines its fixed-quantile objective with true e(X), assumes conditional-law convergence of the endpoint mark to G_0 in condition (10), and derives the infinitely divisible limit in Theorem 3.1 from Propositions 8.2 and 8.3.
Firpo studies QTE estimation by nonparametric propensity estimation and two quantile minimizations, proving root-n asymptotic normality and semiparametric efficiency in the regular regime.
The paper establishes efficiency of inverse weighting by a nonparametrically estimated propensity score for the average treatment effect, not Hall-tail quantile inference.
The paper studies irregular inverse-weight estimation under weak support and explains why rates can be slower than parametric, including an exogenous-selection treatment-effect example.
